notes: Compatible patch release carrying the accepted read-only, default-off enrollment-policy foundation for issue #333. The additive auth-v2 response publishes the required closed, invite-only, and self-signup enrollment_mode vocabulary through one durable provider-backed policy document. Stored overrides apply only to the exact non-boolean integer schema-v1 shape; missing, malformed, boolean, string, old, and future documents preserve the complete deployed restricted-preview baseline. The release changes no /api/v1 behavior and adds no enrollment enforcement, audit trail, Admin mutation, readiness policy, RBAC, UI, provider or public enablement, signup, OAuth, mail, or invitation production behavior. It retains the MySQL schema-two/schema-three rollback bridge with apply_policy held, production at exact schema two, and exact immutable v0.9.5.39 as the application-only predecessor; database rollback is prohibited. Schema-three activation, the MySQL composite transaction, receipt-table grant and drift hardening, remaining enrollment administration and enforcement, routes, games, Slots adoption, ledger behavior, provider scaling, and all-provider atomicity remain separately governed. Issue #333 and issues #430/#471 remain open. No provider selection or configuration, DNS, billing, public exposure, credential, or SSH-ingress behavior changes.
